products.name: Clearscope
products.note: Content optimization AI; readability scoring; competitor content analysis

profile_text.body:
Clearscope is a content optimization platform that describes itself as a discoverability platform for search and AI-powered platforms. According to its website, the product helps users improve and monitor their visibility in Google, ChatGPT, Gemini, and similar services, covering what the company calls both SEO and GEO (generative engine optimization). The site states that Clearscope shows users which sources large language models draw on when compiling answers, and positions this transparency as a core part of its offering.

The platform's features, as described on its site, span topic research, prompt tracking, AI content generation, and content optimization, with the stated goal of helping users establish topical authority and accelerate content production. The site includes a quote from Ethan Smith, CEO at Graphite, describing the tool as tying together research and generation workflows, and another from Eda Kavlakoğlu citing its usefulness for identifying low-competition topics early. The company says it serves customers ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies.

The held facts confirm Clearscope is tracked under the Writing and Editing category, with its core product noted for content optimization, readability scoring, and competitor content analysis. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
